# Google AI Plus Portal — Complete Technical & User Guide

> Version: 1.0.1
> Web Portal: https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/
> Desktop Repository: https://github.com/nmrisrl11/gemini-ai-plus-portal
> Web Repository: https://github.com/nmrisrl11/gemini-ai-plus-app
> License: MIT

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Google AI Plus Portal is an independent, open-source Windows 10/11 desktop utility designed to streamline 12-month Google AI Plus promotional onboarding and resolve your direct Google One offer link locally.

The companion web portal (`https://gemini-ai-plus-portal.vercel.app/`) is built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, and Three.js. It provides a read-only interactive UI preview using RFC 2606 sample data (`@example.com`), a four-step 3D scroll walkthrough, a feature spotlight, and a topic-filtered FAQ—without collecting or transmitting any user information.

---

## 2. Included Google AI Plus Plan Benefits

The 12-month Google AI Plus promotional tier includes:

- **Gemini app**: Double usage limits plus Hydrogen model access.
- **400 GB cloud storage**: Shared across Google Photos, Drive, and Gmail.
- **Google Flow & Music**: Expanded AI creative and music studio access.
- **Search, Gmail & Notebook**: Nano Banana in Search, Gmail AI, and Audio Overviews.

---

## 3. Four-Step Local Workflow

1. **01 · Setup**: Generate ready-to-use profile details in one click inside the Windows desktop app, or enter your own.
2. **02 · Browser**: Connects directly to an existing Chromium browser already installed on your PC (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, or Vivaldi) with zero extra browser downloads.
3. **03 · Confirm**: Pauses automatically whenever an email confirmation step or human security check appears so you can complete it safely in your browser before automation resumes.
4. **04 · Ready**: Captures your direct Google One offer link and saves a local backup copy in the `results/` folder next to the app.

---

## 4. Key Engineering & UX Highlights

- **Works with your existing browser**: Automatically detects Chrome, Windows Edge, Brave, Opera, or Vivaldi, avoiding ~420 MB bundled browser downloads.
- **Private by default**: Everything runs on your Windows PC—no sign-ups, no tracking, no remote backend, and no telemetry.
- **Single portable Windows file**: Lightweight (~43 MB) standalone build compiled via GitHub Actions with published checksums and automated VirusTotal scan reports on every release.
- **Safe pauses & recovery**: Pauses cleanly for security checks, includes an `F12` in-app simulation/diagnostics mode, and offers a recovery helper if a run is interrupted halfway.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

### Q1: Does the app send my details to any server?
Never. Everything runs directly on your Windows PC with no accounts, tracking, or remote servers. Your details and offer links stay in a local folder right next to the app.

### Q2: Do I need to install anything else first?
No. Just download the single Windows file and double-click to open. It works with Chrome, Edge, or Brave already on your computer, so there are no extra browsers or runtimes to install.

### Q3: Why does Google One show a billing step?
Google One requires a billing profile on file during promotional checkout on Google One. The 12-month promotional period is $0.00 today, and auto-renewal can be turned off anytime in your Google One settings.

### Q4: What if a security check or CAPTCHA pops up?
The app pauses automatically and lets you complete the check yourself in the browser window before continuing, keeping your account safe from lockouts.

### Q5: What if something gets interrupted halfway?
You don't have to start over. If your connection drops or a window closes mid-way, the built-in recovery helper can reconnect to your browser and finish grabbing your link.

### Q6: How do I know the download is safe?
Every release is open source and built automatically from public code on GitHub, complete with an independent VirusTotal scan and file checksum so you can verify it yourself.

---

## 6. Security, Privacy & Compliance Disclosures

- **100% Local**: No remote API servers, cloud relays, or analytics.
- **Read-Only Web Preview**: The web landing page contains zero `<input>` or `<form>` elements and uses strictly synthetic `@example.com` sample data.
